column4: S4 lead: in the resubmission mirror (HEAD 78ffb06d + the wave + the I8 fixes) cov_r_flic_input's Win32 boot returned SG_E_NO_RESOURCE at record 0 of 75 in 2 of 42 runs of that build (the first boot_win32 gate run, boot_win32_try1.tsv, and one single run, boot_w32_flic_3.tsv), both while the machine's free commit was 8 to 10 GB; the same build then passed 40 of 40 (flic_rate.log), a build that logs the missing name 120 of 120 (s4rx_flic_runs.log, s4rx_missing.txt never written), I8's mirror 45 of 45, and the re-run boot_win32 gate 70 rows with 0 differing from I7b. x64 passed every run. The Win32 runner does not report run_detail, so the missing name of the two failures is not known.
column5: Catch the name in a failing run: the instrumented build port/build/S4rx appends sg_run_frames' run_detail to log/roadmap/S4/resub/s4rx_missing.txt; run it under low free commit.
